name.ja: Figure-rise Mechanics オボッチャマン

description.ja: 『Dr.スランプ アラレちゃん』より、オボッチャマンがFigure-rise Mechanicsに登場！
description.en: From "Dr. Slump Arale-chan", Obocchaman appears in Figure-rise Mechanics!

description.ja: • 内部構造から組み上げていくこだわりの工程で「本物」のオボッチャマンを作ることができる。
description.en: • You can make a ``real'' Obocchaman through a carefully assembled process that begins with the internal structure.

description.ja: • さまざまな表情を付けられるハンドパーツに加え、エネルギー源のロボビタンA、アラレちゃんの表情替え用「ほよよ顔」パーツが付属。
description.en: • In addition to hand parts that can be used to express various expressions, Robovitan A, the energy source, and a "cheerful face" part for changing Arale's expressions are also included.

description.ja: • 別売りの「Figure-rise Mechanics アラレちゃん」と頭部の付け替えが可能。
description.en: • The head can be replaced with "Figure-rise Mechanics Arale-chan" (sold separately).

accessories.ja: ロボビタンAを握る手（右手）×1
accessories.en: Hand holding Robovitan A (right hand) x 1

accessories.ja: アラレちゃんほよよ顔×1
